ponder.magicinduction.title: Ponder
ponder.magicinduction.empty: No notes for this item yet
ponder.magicinduction.mana_butterfly_spa: Creative mode only. Right-click to spawn one Mana Butterfly. Wild butterflies are picky: open sky, light level 9 or higher, magic leaves within 6 blocks, and only 5 per 32x32 area for the lifetime of the world. This lets you skip the search and test jar capture and induction right away.
ponder.magicinduction.butterfly_jar.p1.b: Turns one lucky encounter into a portable asset. Holds up to 5 Mana Butterflies. A full jar glows with enchantment shine and refuses to take more.
ponder.magicinduction.butterfly_jar.p2.b: Hold the jar and right-click a Mana Butterfly. They never spawn in caves - only under open sky, at light level 9 or higher, near magic leaves, and a patch of woods yields at most 5 in its lifetime. If a patch of cobblestone has quietly turned into glowing violet ore, one is nearby.
ponder.magicinduction.butterfly_jar.p3.b: Right-click a Mana Inducer to install the jar. The machine converts cobblestone touching its north, south, east and west sides. More butterflies means faster conversion - five butterflies is about one block per second, so four sides empty in seconds. Keep feeding it.
ponder.magicinduction.mana_inducer.p1.b: Turns bottled butterflies into a converter. It never creates ore from nothing - it only replaces the cobblestone touching its four sides with Basic Magic Ore, one block at a time. All four sides look the same, so its facing makes no difference.
ponder.magicinduction.mana_inducer.p2.b: 1) Right-click with a jar full of butterflies. 2) Right-click with Mana Dust. 3) Place cobblestone on all four sides, touching the machine. Each block lights up and turns to ore - remember to refill the empty side. The four side lamps light clockwise, one per butterfly; with five, the central ring glows too.
ponder.magicinduction.mana_inducer.p3.b: Each converted block costs 1 Mana Dust, and each ore block drops exactly 1 Crystal plus 1 Dust - so dust breaks even. The only thing you really have to supply is cobblestone: a cobblestone generator feeding this machine gives you a steady supply of Magic Crystals.
ponder.magicinduction.magic_ore.p1.b: Requires an iron pickaxe or better. Drops exactly 1 Magic Crystal and 1 Mana Dust, plus 2 to 4 experience. Fortune increases the crystals; the dust always stays at 1.
ponder.magicinduction.magic_ore.p2.b: It never generates naturally. It appears only where a wild butterfly converted cobblestone, or where a Mana Inducer converted a region in bulk.
ponder.magicinduction.mana_dust.p1.b: Fuel for the Mana Inducer. Every converted block consumes 1 dust. Without dust the machine stops and tells you why.
ponder.magicinduction.mana_dust.p2.b: Dropped by Basic Magic Ore. Since 1 dust converts 1 block and 1 block yields 1 dust, the ledger balances: you can convert exactly as much as you mined.
ponder.magicinduction.magic_crystal.p1.b: The core material for crafting a Mana Inducer, and butterfly food: feed one crystal to each of two butterflies to breed them. With Create installed, stirring crystals in a heated basin yields 250 mB of Mana Essence.
ponder.magicinduction.magic_planks.p1.b: Magic Planks are part of the vanilla planks tag, so vanilla recipes - chests, crafting tables, bookshelves, torches, bowls - accept them as-is. Stack two planks vertically for a Magic Stick, then pair planks with sticks to make a sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe. Durability and mining speed match vanilla wooden tools exactly; only the colour is different. They also burn in a furnace for 15 seconds each.
